bifrost: springboard/src/shell/atspi/ (AT-SPI2 bridge), springboard/ui/src/ax.rs, springboard/sdk/src/lib.rs (controls_tree, ax_set), springboard/proto/src/lib.rs (Configure, reduce_motion, text_scale), springboard/src/shell/accessibility/mod.rs, springboard/src/shell/magnifier.rs, springboard/src/shell/assistive_touch.rs
summary: BifrOSt covers a Linux AT-SPI2 screen-reader bridge (roles, states, text attributes, text events, announcements, secure fields) and system display settings (zoom, reduce motion, increase contrast, reduce transparency, larger and bold text) that apps can read. The hierarchy API exists in the SDK but no app uses it yet, and there is no Accessibility Inspector, Switch Control, Voice Control, Braille, or audio-graph support.

features.note: Kit draw helpers now record parent links (ax::begin_group/end_group) and the runtime sends them as ControlsTree entries, so the sidebar list nests its rows without app changes; ViewApp already sent the view tree. The menu bar, its menus, the dock apps and Spotlight are published as a "BifrOSt Shell" application on the AT-SPI bus. Chrome is read-only (press is not routed yet) and Spotlight is a placeholder entry without live text. Only the sidebar draws groups so far; other immediate-mode helpers stay flat. Needs a Midget check with Orca for parity.
Name falls back from label to title, Description from help to role name; SDK hooks App::ax_meta and View::ax_meta exist. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 6 (0.5.44); verify on Midget for parity.

features.feature: System accessibility settings readable by apps

features.bifrost: springboard/proto/src/lib.rs:44 (Configure: reduce_motion, text_scale), springboard/render/src/appearance.rs (reduce_motion, increase_contrast, reduce_transparency), springboard/src/shell/accessibility/mod.rs
features.note: Apps receive reduce_motion and text_scale through Configure; contrast and transparency reach apps through the renderer (calendar-desktop follows them, see springboard/apps/calendar-desktop/CHANGELOG.md). No single SDK AccessibilitySettings struct.
Display Zoom is a 1.0 or 1.15 geometry factor, not a system-wide zoom. Magnifier is a camera loupe with digital zoom and filters, not a screen magnifier. No screen-wide zoom.
A floating Home button with six system shortcuts, plus hold-duration settings from 0.5 s to 2 s. No pointer-based keys or dwell control.

Shell chrome is in the AT-SPI tree but read-only (press is not routed back) and Spotlight has no live text.

The AT-SPI bridge is untested on a live Orca; unit tests cover only wire round trips and mapping.
